input:
Problem: Mobile layout breaks with horizontal scrollbar caused by fixed pixel width container. Code:

Systems Overview
output:

Hardcoded width w-[1200px] prevents mobile responsiveness. Should use max-w-7xl w-full.

```diff
-<main class="w-[1200px] mx-auto px-4 py-8">
+<main class="w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-8">
```

Verification:
Playwright Level 4: Emulate iPhone viewport (375px) and assert document.body.scrollWidth == window.innerWidth. -> passed

instruction: Diagnose and provide minimal fix for: Search input in navigation lacks accessible label causing screen reader silence.

context.test: Level 7 Accessibility Audit: Check aria-label accessibility mapping on all input controls.

input:
Problem: Search input in navigation lacks accessible label causing screen reader silence.
Code:
<form role="search" class="flex items-center">
  <input type="text" class="px-3 py-1 bg-zinc-800 text-white rounded" />
  <button type="submit">Search</button>
</form>
output:
Diagnosis:
The input has no <label for=...> and no aria-label attribute.

Minimal Patch:
```diff
-  <input type="text" class="px-3 py-1 bg-zinc-800 text-white rounded" />
+  <input type="text" aria-label="Search documentation" placeholder="Search documentation..." class="px-3 py-1 bg-zinc-800 text-white rounded" />
```

Verification:
Level 7 Accessibility Audit: Check aria-label accessibility mapping on all input controls. -> passed

metadata.description: Diagnose and provide minimal fix for: Search input in navigation lacks accessible label causing screen reader silence.

instruction: Diagnose and provide minimal fix for: Form button without explicit type causes unintentional form submission on click.

context.test: Playwright Level 4: Click 'Options' button and assert page URL does not reload or submit.

input:
Problem: Form button without explicit type causes unintentional form submission on click.
Code:
<form class="space-y-4">
  <input type="email" placeholder="Email address" required />
  <button class="bg-zinc-800 text-white px-3 py-1" onclick="toggleAdvancedOptions()">Options</button>
  <button type="submit" class="bg-indigo-600 text-white px-4 py-2">Submit</button>

output:

HTML default type for <button> inside a <form> is 'submit'. Auxiliary buttons must specify type='button'.

-  <button class="bg-zinc-800 text-white px-3 py-1" onclick="toggleAdvancedOptions()">Options</button>
+  <button type="button" class="bg-zinc-800 text-white px-3 py-1" onclick="toggleAdvancedOptions()">Options</button>
```

Verification:
Playwright Level 4: Click 'Options' button and assert page URL does not reload or submit. -> passed

instruction: Diagnose and provide minimal fix for: Form button without explicit type causes unintentional form submission on click.

context.test: Playwright Level 4: Click 'Options' button and assert page URL does not reload or submit.

input:
Problem: Form button without explicit type causes unintentional form submission on click.
Code:
<form class="space-y-4">
  <input type="email" placeholder="Email address" required />
  <button class="bg-zinc-800 text-white px-3 py-1" onclick="toggleAdvancedOptions()">Options</button>
  <button type="submit" class="bg-indigo-600 text-white px-4 py-2">Submit</button>
</form>
output:
Diagnosis:
HTML default type for <button> inside a <form> is 'submit'. Auxiliary buttons must specify type='button'.

Minimal Patch:
```diff
-  <button class="bg-zinc-800 text-white px-3 py-1" onclick="toggleAdvancedOptions()">Options</button>
+  <button type="button" class="bg-zinc-800 text-white px-3 py-1" onclick="toggleAdvancedOptions()">Options</button>
```

Verification:
Playwright Level 4: Click 'Options' button and assert page URL does not reload or submit. -> passed

instruction: Diagnose and provide minimal fix for: Search input in navigation lacks accessible label causing screen reader silence.

context.test: Level 7 Accessibility Audit: Check aria-label accessibility mapping on all input controls.

input:
Problem: Search input in navigation lacks accessible label causing screen reader silence.
Code:
<form role="search" class="flex items-center">
  <input type="text" class="px-3 py-1 bg-zinc-800 text-white rounded" />
  <button type="submit">Search</button>
</form>
output:
Diagnosis:
The input has no <label for=...> and no aria-label attribute.

Minimal Patch:
```diff
-  <input type="text" class="px-3 py-1 bg-zinc-800 text-white rounded" />
+  <input type="text" aria-label="Search documentation" placeholder="Search documentation..." class="px-3 py-1 bg-zinc-800 text-white rounded" />
```

Verification:
Level 7 Accessibility Audit: Check aria-label accessibility mapping on all input controls. -> passed
